reading.body:
Google operates a data center campus in Sarpy County as part of its broader Omaha-area presence spanning Douglas County and Sarpy County, Nebraska. The company does not publish individual facility power capacity, square footage, or street addresses; it discloses only aggregate state-level investment figures. A Papillion data center within this campus area was reported at approximately $600 million in local reporting, though this figure is not an official Google specification.

No megawatt capacity is published for this facility, making it impossible to estimate its rack or accelerator count or to compare its scale to other data center campuses. Nebraska has 21 mapped data center facilities across the state, but none of them, including this Google campus, publish power consumption figures on their specification pages. This campus ranks first among published capacity in Nebraska only because no other facility in the state has disclosed a megawatt figure.

The campus sits within a Sarpy County data center corridor that also hosts Yahoo, Travelers, and other operators. Without published power specifications, this campus cannot be ranked against other AI-relevant data center investments or assessed for its significance to national compute infrastructure and grid demand.
